criterion: Mechanical test used: a ret belongs to the function rooted at S only if the stack frame it tears down matches the sub esp,N of S. Tearing down a frame size that no enclosing prologue in the interval allocated means control never came from S, i.e. a separate function. `ret imm16` must also equal the frame owner's argument bytes. Presence of a ret alone decides nothing.
why_ret_alone_is_insufficient: MSVC emits a ret after every early-return path, so one function routinely contains many rets; conversely NOP padding between functions means consecutive functions also produce many rets. The two cases are indistinguishable without checking the frame the ret unwinds against the enclosing prologue.
